nom: The Ordinary Salicylic Acid 2% Anhydrous Solution, Gentle Exfoliating Serum for Blemishes

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin are sharply split: several, including ones with extremely oily or seborrheic-prone skin, report the oil-based formula cleared their acne effectively, while others with oily skin say it made them break out more or recommend the water-based version instead for oily skin.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin are also split: several, including some with eczema or keratosis-prone skin, report it clears blemishes without the dryness or burning other salicylic acid products cause them; a few other dry-skin reviewers, however, say it broke them out unexpectedly.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report mixed results: several say it minimized pores, improved texture, and calmed even nodular-cystic acne after an initial rough patch, while others with combination skin report it caused more whiteheads and cystic breakouts than they normally get.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive skin report good tolerance, describing it as gentler and less drying than the original water-based salicylic acid and effective on blemishes with gradual, moderate use; one reviewer with sensitive, acne-prone skin, however, says it broke her out and had to stop.
segments.mature: Most reviewers who state their age, ranging from their 40s to 70, report gentle, positive results on occasional blemishes and enlarged pores; one reviewer, however, found it too strong and drying for her mature skin and needed a barrier cream to recover.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say the oil base keeps skin from drying out the way other salicylic acid products do, describing it as moisturizing or even a fix for dryness caused by prior treatments. A few reviewers, however, report the opposite: skin left very dry, tight, or flaking, with one needing a barrier cream to recover.
concerns.redness: A couple of reviewers specifically mention redness: one says her cheeks became noticeably less red with continued use, while another experienced some peeling and slight redness after trying it once.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers credit the product with helping repair a compromised skin barrier and reducing irritation bumps; others caution that overusing any salicylic acid product, including this one, or skipping SPF can damage the skin barrier or increase sun sensitivity, and recommend easing in gradually.
concerns.blemishes: A large number of reviewers report the product significantly cleared blemishes, including stubborn cystic or nodular acne, often after an initial one-to-few-week purging phase that resolves with continued use. An also-substantial number, however, report the opposite: new pimples, whiteheads, or cystic breakouts appearing in areas or at a frequency they don't normally experience, sometimes prompting them to stop entirely.
concerns.oiliness: Many reviewers, especially among the critical reviews, describe the product as leaving skin very oily or greasy, sometimes requiring blotting sheets or a long wait before it absorbs; other reviewers, however, say the light oily finish settles into a smoother, satin feel and even helps balance oily skin that is dehydrated underneath.

aspects.libelle: Strong, unpleasant smell (rancid, chemical, or musty)
Oily texture that takes a long time to absorb
Requires SPF due to increased sun sensitivity
Useful beyond the face for scalp and body exfoliation
Often requires a multi-week purging period before results

extraits.titre: Worst salicylic product I've ever used
extraits.texte: I bought this product since the salicylic product I usually use wasn't in store so I picked this up instead since I've used the ordinary product before and they've worked well for me. Not the case with this one at all. I have combination skin and suffer from the occasional cystic pimple around my time of the month. My skin had been absolutely clear prior to using this product. Once I used this product I developed white heads galore on my forehead and cystic pimples on my cheeks which I NEVER get only on the chin area around my time of the month. I gave it a try for a full month and my skin only got worse. This is most definitely not made for combination or oily skin. DO NOT RECOMMEND WHATSOEVER!
I struggle with whiteheads as someone with oily skin, and this just made me break out into more! I'm hoping In the future you make some for oily skin.

extraits.titre: Hear me out-- You're just using it wrong!!!
extraits.texte: Okay, I'll admit, I bought this thinking it would be a sort of regular serum. The oil thing freaked me out at first because I do have extremely oily skin. However, I started to use it more often and noticed that my acne (which was fairly common, especially when I was hormonal), pretty much disappeared. I've been using this along with The Ordinary's niacinamide + zinc serum. I use a toner, usually with AHA/BHAs, then water-based serum, then an oil-based serum. Sometimes (rarely) I use moisturizer. I will also use their AHA/BHA mask a couple times a week. However, it's definitely THIS serum that has basically discontinued my acne. My tips: use 2-3 drops if you are not doing facial massage or gua sha. If you are, use about 4 drops. I do recommend facial massage/gua sha, it helps reduce acne scarring. Rub it into the hands and then PRESS it into the face. After a few minutes, gently dab away some of the excess oil. For use under makeup, you can use a bit of powder before applying foundation or concealer. HOWEVER, after using this for a while, I am needing foundation less and less.

Ive used a couple products from the ordinary and I accidentally bought this one. I figured since I have really dry skin that this could work. I can get past the smell but my face broke out the first time I used it, then tried it again to make sure it was that particular product breaking me out. If you have acne problems, I do not reccomend.

extraits.titre: Amazing for my acne dry skin
extraits.texte: I have eczema and overall really dry skin. But im also acne prone. This is the only product i have found that doesnt burn, dry out my skin, or cause an eczema flair. And on top of that! It has tremendously cleared my skin Down side is it does have an odd smell. But nothing horrible. Just a slight earthy smell. But i have a beliver in that skin care shouldn't be scented anyways.

This is VERY drying for me. When applied with moisturizer, there is just too much product on my face. My pores were minimized the next morning though. Had to buy barrier cream to treat the dryness this caused.

Although at 70 years of age my skin looks really good, I still get an occasional pimple on my chin and deal with larger pores on my nose. I had read that Salicylic acid with regular use will control these problems. I am happy to report that I am seeing an improvement after only using this product for two weeks. I used only a little after washing my face both morning and night. I definitely will continue to use and purchase. Also wanted to mention that it a both gentle on the skin and affordable.
